thesis: NEAR Intents is the dominant cross-chain liquidity routing layer, and the NEAR protocol captures durable, measurable value from it through Q4 2026
author: trinnode
measurement_note: All baselines were pulled from public APIs on 2026-11-01 and are recorded in snapshots/baseline/ with SHA-256 hashes. Thresholds were frozen before the measurement windows opened. Kill conditions are numeric so the engine can evaluate them without interpretation.

claims.title: NEAR Intents carries at least 55% of DefiLlama-tracked cross-chain bridge volume
claims.metric_definition: NEAR Intents total7d volume divided by the sum of total7d volume across every protocol in the DefiLlama dexs overview with category Bridge, expressed as a percentage, measured on a trailing 7 day window

baseline.detail: NEAR Intents $884,323,997 of $1,372,204,727 tracked 7d bridge volume across 6 protocols

claims.kill_condition: share below 45% on the measurement date = FALSIFIED
claims.at_risk_zone: share below 50% but at or above 45% = AT_RISK
claims.note: Closes during the judging window. The scoreboard re-verifies this claim live while judges watch.

claims.title: NEAR Intents TVL stays above $180M through Nov 14
claims.metric_definition: totalLiquidityUSD from the DefiLlama protocol endpoint for near-intents, sampled once per night at the snapshot run
claims.kill_condition: TVL below $120M for 3 consecutive nightly snapshots = FALSIFIED
claims.at_risk_zone: TVL below $150M but at or above $120M = AT_RISK

claims.title: Trailing 30 day Intents volume stays above $3.0B
claims.metric_definition: Sum of the last 30 daily points from the DefiLlama dexs summary endpoint for near-intents
claims.kill_condition: trailing 30d volume below $1.8B on the measurement date = FALSIFIED
claims.at_risk_zone: below $2.4B but at or above $1.8B = AT_RISK

claims.title: Trailing 7 day protocol fees stay above $400K
claims.metric_definition: total7d from the DefiLlama fees overview for the near-intents adapter
claims.kill_condition: trailing 7d fees below $150K on the measurement date = FALSIFIED
claims.at_risk_zone: below $275K but at or above $150K = AT_RISK
claims.note: NEAR announced in 2026 that protocol revenue from intent executions funds NEAR buybacks, which makes fee capture a first class metric for the thesis.

claims.title: BEAR CASE: NEAR market cap does NOT exceed 5% of ETH market cap
claims.metric_definition: NEAR usd_market_cap divided by ETH usd_market_cap from CoinGecko simple price endpoint, sampled nightly
claims.kill_condition: ratio at or above 0.05 on any nightly snapshot = FALSIFIED. This is a deliberate bear guard: if NEAR outruns ETH by 2.5x in two weeks the thesis framing loses, and the scoreboard says so

claims.title: NEAR price does not close below $3.00 during the window
claims.metric_definition: NEAR spot price in USD from CoinGecko, sampled once per nightly snapshot
claims.kill_condition: price below $2.00 on any nightly snapshot = FALSIFIED
claims.at_risk_zone: price below $2.60 but at or above $2.00 = AT_RISK

claims.title: META: 12 of 12 scheduled nightly snapshots land with valid hashes
claims.metric_definition: Number of nightly snapshots committed between Nov 2 and Nov 13 inclusive (12 scheduled) that appear in snapshots/manifest.json with a matching SHA-256 and git commit, divided by 12

baseline.detail: 0 of 12 snapshots completed at window open

claims.kill_condition: any scheduled snapshot missing or hash-invalid at window close = FALSIFIED. The thesis verification process itself is on the scoreboard
